description: An odd, lopsided creature with three oversized paddle feet, mismatched heavy-lidded eyes, crooked feelers and one inconvenient tooth.
silhouette: A wonky clay-colored pear, a leaning crown, bent feelers and three broad, splayed feet.
mannerisms: An uneven three-footed galumph; the rear foot catches up late.
One bent feeler seems to receive a different signal than the other.
A deadpan sideways look followed by a slightly excessive whole-body lean.
Mismatched slow blinks and a long, unimpressed pause.
